Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the very first step, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly identify the prize. While the search results clearly showed the "Adam Smith Prizes" at the University of Cambridge (awarded for the Economics Tripos), the agent's text response incorrectly focused on and named "Treasury Today's Adam Smith Awards" as the primary result, stating it was "the annual corporate treasury prize named after the author of The Wealth of Nations." This was a hallucination or misinterpretation of the search results, as the visible text in the viewport explicitly highlighted the Wikipedia entry about the University of Cambridge prize first and most prominently. By misidentifying the prize and the awarding body immediately, the agent set a false trajectory, although the Planner subsequently corrected the course by finding the correct Cambridge information in later steps. However, the initial error in identification by WebSurfer is the root cause of the confusion.
